SELECT
  t0.month_label AS month,
  COALESCE(t1.orders_count, 0) AS orders_count,
  COALESCE(t2.review_count, 0) AS review_count,
  ROUND(
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(t1.orders_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE COALESCE(t2.review_count, 0)::decimal / t1.orders_count * 100
    END, 2
  ) AS reviews_per_100_orders,
  ROUND(COALESCE(t2.avg_rating, 0), 2) AS avg_rating
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT month_label, month_start
  FROM calendar_days
  WHERE calendar_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND calendar_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
) t0
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', o.placed_at)::date AS month_start,
    COUNT(*) AS orders_count
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.placed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled')
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.placed_at)::date
) t1 ON t1.month_start = t0.month_start
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', r.created_at)::date AS month_start,
    COUNT(*) AS review_count,
    AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating
  FROM product_reviews r
  WHERE r.is_approved = true
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', r.created_at)::date
) t2 ON t2.month_start = t0.month_start
ORDER BY t0.month_start ASC
note: Built off calendar_days so every month 2023-01..2025-12 appears even with zero orders/reviews; reviews_per_100_orders is 0 when orders_count is 0 to avoid divide-by-zero, and avg_rating is 0 (not null) for months with no approved reviews.
